hero.title: A Professional Foundation for Modern React Applications
hero.subtitle: Built to provide a clean, production-ready structure inspired by modern web standards and sleek aesthetics.

features.sectionTitle: Everything you need to launch your next project
features.sectionSubtitle: Prebuilt components, full state management, and unified design tokens saving you hundreds of development hours.

theme.title: Integrated Design & Custom Themes
theme.desc: Colors, fonts, and CSS variables managed from a single source of truth or live from the dashboard.

security.title: Advanced RBAC & Security
security.desc: Fine-grained role-based permissions, AES client-side encryption, and route protection guards.

perf.title: Lightning Fast Performance
perf.desc: Automatic code splitting, lazy-loaded routes with error boundary fallbacks for optimal UX.

i18n.title: Full Arabic & English Localization
i18n.desc: Dynamic namespace loader supporting seamless RTL/LTR layout transitions without page reloads.

dashboard.title: Professional Admin Panel
dashboard.desc: Responsive management layout with collapsible sidebar and dark mode support.

api.title: Advanced API Architecture
api.desc: Centralized Axios client with automatic interceptors, toast notifications, and LRU memory caching.
